## About
Giannini's Auto Service is a family-owned repair shop on W Woodbine Ave in Kirkwood. Don Giannini runs the shop as owner and president, and the way he sees it, the car in your driveway is worth taking care of.
Don believes the maintenance schedule in your owner's manual isn't written to help you avoid buying a new car. So the shop focuses on keeping your current vehicle dependable, and some customers have even handed their cars down to their kids.
We're open weekdays and hold a 4.4 rating from 162 Google reviews.

## Services
- Complete brake service: Brake inspection and repair.
- Missouri state inspections: State vehicle inspections done at the shop.
- Air conditioning repair: Repair for your car's air conditioning.
- BG fluid flush services: Fluid flush services using BG products.
- Battery and tire services: Battery and tire work, from simple tire repairs on up.
- Engine replacements: Bigger jobs too, all the way up to engine replacements.

## FAQ
Q: What days are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How is your fluid service different from a quick lube?
A: We use BG products and equipment. The cleaning chemical that goes into the system first is what makes the difference.

Q: Are you hiring?
A: If you're interested in working with us, fill out the form on our contact page and we'll get back to you to schedule an interview.
